newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat called steady, possibly higher.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat called steady, possibly higher.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures were called by traders mostly steady, but a few traders said talk Egypt may tender soon for about 500,000 tonnes of wheat could provide a slight boost to futures.

Cash wheat markets were quiet early Thursday. Lower basis values at U.S. Gulf export points could keep a lid on futures early. Hard red winter wheat delivered to Galveston was bid 66 cents per bushel over KCBT March wheat, down from 68 cents over on Tuesday.
